What We Do

Complete Property Care,
Inside & Out

From a leaking tap to a full garden overhaul — Summit handles every job with the same professionalism and attention to detail.

🔨

Handyman Services

Cabinet installations, light electrical tasks, fencing installation, and all manner of general repairs — done right the first time.

🌿

Lawn & Garden Care

Regular mowing, garden tidy-ups, hedge trimming, weeding, mulching, and light landscaping tailored to the Sunshine Coast lifestyle.

🏡

Property Maintenance

Pressure washing, gutter cleaning, solar panel maintenance, and ongoing care packages for homeowners, landlords, and busy families.

🚜

Site Work & Concrete

With an HR licence and White Card, Cameron brings professional site preparation, concreting, and earthmoving to larger jobs.

🌱

Landscaping & Turf

Full garden transformations, artificial turf laying, paving, and outdoor space redesigns that add real value to your property.

📅

Flexible Scheduling

Available weekdays and weekends — Cameron has quoted on a Saturday within 30 minutes and completed the job that same afternoon.

About Cameron

Built on Reliability,
Delivered with Pride

Cameron Prichard is the dedicated owner of Summit Home and Lawn Solutions. With over 8 years of hands-on construction and trades experience — from casual labour through to independent contracting and team leadership — he brings genuine expertise to every property he works on.

Serving homeowners, landlords, and busy families across the Sunshine Coast, Noosa, and Brisbane. Fully insured, locally operated, and built around one thing: getting the job done properly.
